RousePresDeterm0.description: Envoy. The targeted ally becomes Determined. 07-24v: replaced a name-gated useItem hook whose body also name-checked five more talents (iron rule 2b). `mark: false` because this is a BUFF on an ally — writing markedBy.determined would put an enemy-debuff ownership flag on a friend, on the shared damage read path. NOTE the printed 'until the end of the scene' was already fiction: nothing clears Determined, before or after this conversion. 07-24w (Ben's ruling): Determined now expires at the END OF COMBAT — the printed 'until the end of the scene' had never been enforced by anything, and end-of-combat is what he ruled.

RouseLessons0000.description: Envoy UPGRADE RIDER — Lessons in Patience. The one rider in this cluster that was ever a real mechanic (edhaGainFocus(t, 1)); the other four were honour-system strings. Gated on the document via whenOwnsTalent, so Lessons in Patience's own sheet carries no rule — declared in the tree-section header (Ben 07-24t: an empty Events tab is acceptable; the test is editability).

RouseInstill0000.description: Envoy UPGRADE RIDER — Instill Confidence. A REMINDER, not a mechanic, and it was one before this conversion too: the old code computed `focusedInstead` and used it for nothing but this string, applying Determined unconditionally regardless. Now editable in Foundry instead of being a template literal in the engine.

handler.text: You may swap Determined for Focused on the target (toggle by hand).

RouseDevoted0000.description: Envoy UPGRADE RIDER — Devoted Presence. A REMINDER: the real mechanic needs a CLEAR-statuses payload, which nothing in the project has. It removes ALL FOUR conditions and is NOT a pick, so the classification's H6 dependency was wrong. The 1-focus cost is already real data on Devoted Presence's own activation.consume.

handler.text: Spend 1 focus to remove Prone, Slowed, Stunned and Surprised from the target (all four — clear them by hand and deduct the focus).

RouseStalwart000.description: Envoy UPGRADE RIDER — Stalwart Presence. A REMINDER: edha-defense-buff cannot express this. Its sweep reads the BUFFED actor's own items so it is self-only, its window enum has a single `round-until-turn` value so 'until scene end' is unsayable, and it returns after the first match so one actor cannot hold two.

handler.text: Spend 1 focus to give the target +2 to one defense until the end of the scene (GM applies).

RouseRallying000.description: Envoy UPGRADE RIDER — Rallying Shout. A REMINDER; the recovery-die half needs a TARGET-scoped formula, which no handler has (every @ formula resolves against the owner). BEHAVIOUR NOTE: this now prints on every use, where the old code gated it on the ally being at 0 HP — that gate hid the card's FIRST clause ('revive an Unconscious ally'), so always-print is the more faithful reading of the card. The Leadership half IS owner data and is shown resolved.

handler.text: You may revive an Unconscious ally. If the target is at 0 health it recovers its recovery die + @skills.ldr.rank health (roll the target's own die).
